name: vq2_dark_red_partial
description: The CROPPED/PARTIAL arm of vq2_dark_red: IDENTICAL real-matched appearance (dark industrial hangar, glowing signage-printed gates), vq1_partial's camera envelope. Camera CLOSE (1.2-6 m) with the boresight pushed ~half-FOV off the target so the gate spills over a frame edge and its CENTRE is often off-frame -- the regime the M+1 centre head and the partial-corner rescue exist for, and per vq2-corner-free-centre-architecture 52.9% of ticks inside 2 m are un-hand-labelable for exactly this reason. Crop behaviour lives in viewpoint.partial_gates, so this is a separate preset rather than a flag on the base one, mirroring how vq1_partial pairs with vq1_faithful. Measured over 24 rendered frames against 400 real frames: background median gray 34.3 vs 36.7 real, gate hue 17.9 vs 17.8 deg, saturation 213 vs 205, value 210 vs 206. Label pipeline verified OFF DISK on the same batch: 2.167 gates/frame, centre sidecars 24/24 and row-for-row with the pose labels, occlusion census hidden=8 (13.3%) -- byte-identical to a vq1_partial control rendered at the same seed, which is the proof that this appearance change does not touch geometry or labels. See vq2_dark_red for the knob-interaction notes.
